maps.name: Knot
maps.note: XS, 9 platforms, choke, inward. The axis switch (Forge, review 2026-09-29: was a rotor) holds the map together: its two fixed decks go up to the pockets a / a', and its switched bridges connect either the middle road (m / m', state 1) and the axis platforms above and below (u / w, state 2), so whoever fires it decides whether the middle road crosses. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

findings.msg: relay 6: no clear ledge, the tower holds the socket

maps.name: Drawbridge Cross
maps.note: XS, 10 platforms, choke, inward. Both axis platforms are retract relays (review 2026-09-29: the bottom too). The top one: its two bridges down to the left and right pockets are drawbridges (two decks - a commitment), so firing it cuts the top lane in one go and the fight moves through the middle platforms and the bottom axis. Survivor ring: everything but the homes.

maps.name: Hex Switch
maps.note: M, 15 platforms, open, inward. A hexagon of platforms round a 6-bridge switch hub (Forge): state 1 bridges the bottom centre and the two top sides, state 2 the top centre and the two bottom sides (review 2026-09-29), so every fire moves all three roads into the hub. The hub has no fixed deck; its bridges hold it in every state (a relay hub). Braided pockets outside. Survivor ring: the hub and the hexagon.

findings.msg: relay 7: no clear ledge, the tower holds the socket

maps.name: Console
maps.note: M, 17 platforms, choke, outward. A king-of-the-hill map: the T4 hill sits on the axis between the two crossings. Each home keeps a remote console (k) one deck away; it raises that side's two shortcuts from the mid platform m up to u and down to w - a home-side console driving a central advantage. The hill falls at the Last Stand; the rim with the consoles and both crossings survives.

maps.name: Switchyard
maps.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. Two lanes on each side meet a 6-way switch on the axis (fixed decks to m / m', a switched bridge up to the top gate u or down to the bottom gate w). The top and bottom axis platforms are gates now (review 2026-09-29: relays were easy to avoid): each draws up its two lane bridges, and its fixed decks go down to the mid platforms. Every crossing of the axis is a relay.

findings.msg: relay 7: no clear ledge, the tower holds the socket

maps.name: Ring Road
maps.note: L, 19 platforms, open, inward, 2v2. A ring road runs round the map; teammates share k. The centre is a rotor hub: its pair of bridges turns from the middle road (m / m') to the axis (t / z), and it has no fixed deck. The bottom diagonal platforms beside it are gates (review 2026-09-29: always some risk near the centre): each draws up its bridge into the hub (a gate on the top diagonals would face the camera, rule G09; they keep no bridge into the hub, which leaves the hub's relay button a free 90-degree slot above it, rule G11). Survivor ring: everything inside the ring road.

findings.msg: relay 9: no clear ledge, the tower holds the socket

maps.name: Rim Run
maps.note: L, 18 platforms, open, both finales. A rim ring round a T4 hill, crossing the axis on top (t) and at the bottom twice (z, y). In the core m is a retract relay: its decks into the hill and up to u retract. On the rim each pocket a is a remote console driving the FAR side's bottom shortcut w'-z (a home-side console, a central advantage). Outward: the rim survives with the consoles; inward: the hill, k / k' and m / m' survive with the retract.

maps.name: Descent
maps.note: L, 19 platforms, choke, inward, three rings. The homes and pockets fall first, then the middle lanes, leaving the centre. The centre is now a rotor hub with no fixed deck (a meat grinder: its pair turns from the middle road to the axis and back, killing whatever is on it), and the bottom diagonal platforms q are gates drawing up their bridge into the hub (review 2026-09-29: experts dodged the old rotor).

findings.msg: relay 9: no clear ledge, the tower holds the socket

maps.name: Grinder
maps.note: S, 13 platforms, choke, inward. A 6-way meat grinder: a hexagon of platforms round a rotor hub whose three bridges (120 degrees apart) turn 60 degrees every fire - bottom centre + top sides, then top centre + bottom sides - so the hub is always connected and every turn kills whatever is on its bridges (review 2026-09-29; short bridges so the hexagon fits). Two lanes per side feed the hexagon. Survivor ring: the hub and the hexagon.

findings.msg: relay 6: no clear ledge, the tower holds the socket

maps.name: Hill
maps.note: M, 15 platforms, choke, inward. A T4 hill on the axis. Each side's mid platform m is a retract relay: its deck into the hill and its deck back to the pocket a retract (a commitment on the main road). The top axis platform t is a remote console that raises the mid-to-bottom shortcuts m-w on both sides (a central console driving the approaches). Survivor ring: the hill, the axis platforms, u / w and m / m'.

Each home's two pockets land on the ring's near side; a high platform over the top pocket drops onto the ring too. Point-symmetric. Survivor ring: the hub and the ring.

maps.name: Rotor
maps.note: Small, 11 platforms, 1 rotor. The centre is a rotating platform (Forge): its two side decks to the X junctions carry the middle road straight across, or it swings to its deck down to the bottom T, sending the flow onto the bottom lane. Its upper decks to the top platforms stay fixed. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X, T. Inward Last Stand keeps the rotor.

maps.name: Twin Rotors
maps.note: Mid, 15 platforms, 2 rotors. Each side's middle road meets a rotating platform that either turns it into the centre (a T4) or swings it down onto the bottom lane; its deck back to the top platform stays fixed. The top and bottom lanes cross the axis at T junctions whose stems hold the centre. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, T. Inward Last Stand keeps the rotors.

maps.name: Triple Rotor
maps.note: Large, 17 platforms, 3 rotors. The centre rotor (Forge) carries the middle road straight across or swings it down to the bottom T; its upper decks to the top rotors stay fixed. The top rotors carry the top lane across the axis T or swing down into the middle platforms. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, T. Inward Last Stand keeps the centre rotor, outward the top rotors.

maps.name: Fork Road
maps.note: Small (11 platforms), 1 relay. Each home's road forks (Junction_Fork) to an upper and a lower platform; both reach the centre Forge, whose lower decks are a drawbridge (retract). The pockets run on to the fork's platforms. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Fork. Inward Last Stand keeps the drawbridge.

maps.name: Crossroads
maps.note: Small (12 platforms), 3 relays. Each home steps onto an X junction that reaches the upper platform, the lower platform and the centre. The centre is a swing (rotation): the two decks to the X junctions (the middle road), or the long deck down to the bottom T, which the gates guard. The lower platforms are gates (retract) on the bottom crossing. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X, T.

maps.name: Knot
maps.note: Small (11 platforms), 5 relays (relay-heavy). Each home's Y junction reaches the two knot platforms; the knot is a K junction in the middle. The upper knot platforms are gates (retract) into the knot, the lower ones switches (the knot or the bottom T), and the top of the axis is a remote console that cuts both homes' Y roads. Bridges: S pockets, M, Y, K, T.

maps.name: Causeway
maps.note: Mid (15 platforms), 1 relay. The middle road is a causeway of T junctions joined by one long junction-to-junction deck; the T stems climb to the top road and drop to the bottom platforms. The centre Forge is a remote console that opens / closes the causeway's last decks. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, T, junction-to-junction L. Inward Last Stand keeps the console.

maps.name: Fork Gates
maps.note: Mid (15 platforms), 3 relays. Each home's road splits at a Fork: the upper arm to the centre switch, the lower arm onto the bottom lane. The centre is a switch: its side decks, or its deck down to the bottom lane's T junction; above it, a fixed triangle to the top platforms. The lower arm's platforms are swings (rotation): up to the switch's side, or across to the bottom T. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Fork, T.

maps.name: Switchyard
maps.note: Mid (15 platforms), 5 relays (relay-heavy). Every home has a switch in front of it: its deck to the upper or the lower centre platform. The centre is a drawbridge (retract) on its upper decks. The top platforms are swings (rotation): across to the T above the centre, or back to the switch; the bottom crossing is a Y. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, T, Y.

maps.name: Three Roads
maps.note: Big, 1 relay. Three roads: the middle one runs through an X junction and a T at the centre, where the Forge's drawbridge (retract) joins them; the top and bottom roads climb from the pockets over L junctions and reach the axis platforms, which the Forge links to (fixed). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X, T, L. Inward Last Stand keeps the drawbridge.

maps.name: Braid
maps.note: Big, 3 relays. Each home's road forks (Fork) and the two strands braid through a K junction before the centre. The centre is a switch: its upper side decks, or its long deck up to the top axis platform. The top and bottom lanes are long T-junction bridges that drop into the braid; the top lane's platforms are remote consoles for the bottom lane's axis crossing (two junction-to-junction decks at a T). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Fork, K, T, junction-to-junction.

maps.name: Ring Road
maps.note: Big, 5 relays (relay-heavy). A ring road around a hub: the centre is an X junction whose four decks reach the two hub platforms and the top / bottom axis platforms. The bottom axis platform is a remote console for the hub's side decks; the hub platforms are swings (rotation) down to the bottom lane or to the console; the top lane has gates (retract) half-way. Each home reaches the ring through an X junction. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X.

maps.name: Team Bridges
maps.note: Special, 2v2, 3 relays. Two homes per side share a Y junction and a K junction knot toward the centre. The centre is a swing (rotation): the upper knot platforms or the top axis T. The top and bottom lanes are long T-junction bridges; the bottom lane's platforms are remote consoles for the top lane's axis crossing. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Y, K, T, junction-to-junction.

maps.name: Arches
maps.note: Curvy, 11 platforms, 1 relay. The pockets climb into two arches - top and bottom - each turned twice by Curve_45s onto an axis platform; the middle road reaches the centre Forge, whose decks from the middle platforms are a drawbridge (retract). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_45.

maps.name: Serpent
maps.note: Curvy, 11 platforms, 3 relays. The middle road is a serpent: out of the home it bends down (Curve_45) onto a switch platform, then up and down again (Curve_45 left, right) into the centre Forge, whose serpent decks are a drawbridge (retract). The switches send the road on along the serpent or down a Curve_45 to the bottom axis platform; the pockets climb to the top one over Curve_45 arches. Bridges: S / M / L, Curve_45.

maps.name: Coil
maps.note: Curvy, 11 platforms, 1 relay. The pockets coil up and down on Curve_90s onto the top and bottom axis platforms (a Curve_90 then a Curve_45 each); the middle platforms reach the centre straight, and the centre is a remote console for those middle decks (the fastest road). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_90, Curve_45. Inward Last Stand keeps the console.

maps.name: Roundabout
maps.note: Curvy, 10 platforms, 3 relays. The centre (a T4) sits in a roundabout: a ring road of curves and junctions that passes through each side's gate platform and meets the centre by the stems of an X at the top and a T at the bottom. The upper ring is a Curve_90 each side, the lower ring two Curve_45s; the gates (retract) hold the lower ring's first decks, and the top platform (over Curve_45 arches, and on the X) is a remote console for the lower ring's last decks. Bridges: S / M / L, Curve_90, Curve_45, X, T.

maps.name: Steps
maps.note: Curvy, 12 platforms, 3 relays. The middle road steps down on a Curve_90 and a Curve_45 onto a gate platform, and climbs to the centre swing (rotation), which points at the two gate platforms or down to the bottom T. The gates (retract) hold the bottom crossing; the top platforms and the top axis platform make the upper lane. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_90, T.

maps.name: Meander
maps.note: Curvy, 11 platforms, 1 relay. The top and bottom lanes meander on Curve_90s: up, across, down, across into the axis platforms. The centre is a remote console for its own decks to the middle platforms (the fastest road). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_90. Inward Last Stand keeps the console.

maps.name: Lens
maps.note: Curvy, 11 platforms, 1 relay. The pockets sweep to the top and bottom axis platforms on crescents of three Curve_45s, so the map is a lens; the middle platforms reach the centre, a remote console for its own middle decks (the fastest road). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_45. Inward Last Stand keeps the console.

maps.name: Figure Eight
maps.note: Curvy, 10 platforms, 3 relays. The middle is a figure eight: an X junction on the axis and on each side a loop round the home's middle platform - a Curve_90 over, a Curve_90 under. The middle platforms are swings (rotation) between the upper and the lower loop; the top axis platform (over Curve_45 arches) is a remote console for the X's upper decks. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_45, Curve_90, X.

maps.name: Waves
maps.note: Curvy, 11 platforms, 1 relay. The top and bottom lanes roll on four Curve_45s each (a wave) to the axis platforms; the middle platforms reach the centre Forge over its drawbridge (retract). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_45. Inward Last Stand keeps the drawbridge.

maps.name: Twin Dips
maps.note: Special 2v2, 12 platforms, 1 relay. Two homes per side share a middle pocket. The top home's pocket climbs over the top on a Curve_45 S-bend to the top axis platform; the bottom home's pocket dips under the centre on a Curve_45 S-bend into a T below it. The top axis platform is a remote console for the shared pockets' decks into the centre (the fastest road). Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, Curve_45, T. Inward Last Stand keeps the console.

maps.name: Small Drawbridge
maps.note: Round 1 relay test (2026-09-28, X-junction lattice), rebuilt 2026-09-29 as X-01: Small lattice (120 x 66 m). One relay: the centre drawbridge (Forge) on the main lane - both its lane decks pull in, closing the middle passage for everyone. The inward Last Stand keeps it; the outward finale plays on the rim without a relay.
